connector.name: Web Search by keenable.ai
connector.registryDescription: Live web search and clean-markdown page fetch over the Keenable web index.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.keenable.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.keenable. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
